drums.tags: Industrial metal with heavy electronic influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted, syncopated riffs in a low tuning. A synthesized bass follows the guitar patterns with a gritty, overdriven tone. The drum kit features a sharp, compressed snare and a punchy kick drum, supplemented by industrial percussion hits and metallic clangs. High-pitched, dissonant synth leads and atmospheric pads provide a dark, mechanical texture. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of D minor.

A metallic, percussive synth sequence provides a rhythmic, industrial texture. High-frequency white noise bursts and distorted hi-hats create a dense, abrasive atmosphere. The arrangement is minimalist and repetitive, focusing on timbral evolution and rhythmic intensity. 135 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
